text:
sara: FYI customers in EU are reporting delayed confirmations; I noticed incident bot didn't page oncall.

ops-bot: automated: Alert 8921 received. Routed to #inc-ops.

eli: saw the alert but no page. Is incident-bot suppressed? :thinking: 

maria: I see the webhook -> incident-orch returned 202, then notify-suppressor returned "suppressed: true" for that route. Logs below:
```
{"alert_id":"8921","route":"eu-support","suppressed":true,"reason":"daily-window-match"}
```

josh: daily-window-match? we didn't schedule any maintenance. Did someone update suppressor rules?

sara: I just deployed a tiny tweak to suppressor regex for "maintenance" yesterday — but shouldn't match here.

eli: Dump of headers from upstream -> "X-Alert-Meta: maintenance=false"

josh: hmm. Could be a precedence bug: if route.name contains "maint" substring, it matches.

ops-bot: automated: escalate attempt 1 -> failed to deliver: no escalation_key found for oncall rotation "eu-1". Fallback route: none.

maria: that explains it. The incident-orch code path thought it delivered to channel, so no manual fallback. We're seeing oncall mapping mismatch + suppressor overlapping rules.

sara: mitigation: run manual reroute to phone for EU oncall. @oncall-rotation can you accept override?
oncall-rotation: accepting. Please run /manual-pager eu-1 8921

eli: running now:
```
/manual-pager eu-1 8921 --mode=phone --force
Result: delivered -> phone ring
```

oncall-rotation: received and acknowledged. :white_check_mark: 

josh: customer impact: Support ticket 7845 shows delayed response window ~18m. We should notify PM & CS.

maria: notified CS (cc: @lucas) — investigating whether any customer-facing timeouts were hit.

sara: next steps:
- revert suppressor regex (sara)
- add unit test for route name matching (eli)
- patch incident-orch to require escalation_key or fallback (josh)
- run an audit for last 24h suppressed=true events (maria)

eli: ETA for patch? Can do a quick fix + deploy in ~40m, test, then full rollback of regex.

josh: temporary playbook entry: if suppressor returns suppressed:true and ops-bot fail to find escalation_key -> create manual page to phone & page Slack #eng-oncall.

sara: logged follow-up ticket: https://go.redwood/issue/INC-3421

maria: I'll quantify impacted customer list and update incident doc.

ops-bot: automated: tagging for postmortem. :memo:
